SCALE.name: SCALE
SCALE.why: M9 scale-only: crop side follows 4x the long side of the latest reliable output box (EMA 0.3, per-frame x[0.8,1.25], floor min(H,W)/4 = the SGGL floor, ceiling min(H,W)); held while output empty/unreliable; centre = SGGL

JOINT.name: JOINT
JOINT.why: M9 translation (frozen M8 FLOWVEL) + scale (SCALE controller, identical parameters)

PCCARRY.name: PCCARRY
PCCARRY.why: M9 cheap motion: while SGGL output is empty, move the crop by the global phase-correlation shift between frames t-1 and t (4x down-sampled gray, FFT; no learned model); else SGGL centre. Mirrors M8 CAMCARRY without RAFT

CONSENSUS.name: CONSENSUS
CONSENSUS.why: M9 presence/abstention (evidence-driven, one rule, no threshold): SGGL, except that when the L self gate fails, the G mask is output only if L also claims presence (score_L > 0); otherwise the output is empty and the crop centre is held. Designed from the MOSEv2 DEV-split replay only (157 FP frames removed vs 124 GT-present frames emptied, J 43.4); judged on MOSEv2 conf and VOST.

NULLJIT.name: NULLJIT
NULLJIT.why: M9 null control (amend3): L crop side = SGGL side x U(0.85,1.15) per frame, seeded by unit; no information
